Privacy

Last updated: 24 October 2026. This notice describes the free beta.

Your images stay on your device

The remover processes your images in your browser. It does not upload them to a processing service. Images and cutouts are held in memory while the page is open. Clear photos or close the tab to discard those working copies. Files you download remain on your device.

Website requests

Your browser downloads the website, sample photo, and cutting engine from our hosting provider. Like other websites, these requests reveal your IP address and basic request information to the hosting provider. The preview host may use authentication cookies to control access. We do not add advertising trackers, third-party analytics, or an image upload endpoint in this beta.

Local storage

Your browser may cache static website files and model files. The app does not put your selected photos in local storage, a database, or the model cache.

External links and support

Links to GitHub and credited projects open external services with their own privacy policies. If you report an issue, do not attach private photos or credentials. Report a privacy or product issue on GitHub.
